changed.title: Worst conditional circuit error on a selector promise from fractional weights on affine cuts
changed.statement:
∀ k m r : ℕ,
  let n := k+2*m+r
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let F := ZMod 2
  let legal := fun (width : ℕ) (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack width C ∧
      (∀ h ∈ C.gates, h.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
        (h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or ∨ h.op = .mod 2 ∨ (h.op = .not ∧ h.inputs.length = 1)))
  let cost := fun (C : Circ) => C.gates.countP (fun h => @decide
    ((h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or) ∧ h.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let bits := fun (width : ℕ) (u : Fin width → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin width => decide (u j = 1))
  let V := Fin n → F
  let S := Fin k → F
  let D := Fin m → F
  let Z := Fin r → F
  let base := 2*m+r
  ∀ (e : V ≃ₗ[F] S × (D × (D × Z))) (A : Fin m → S) (h : S → F),
    let word := fun (s : S) (i : Fin m) => dotProduct (A i) s
    let score := fun (C : Circ) (s : S) =>
      (∑ x : V, ∑ b : D, ∑ c : D, ∑ z : Z,
        let y := e.symm (s,(b,(c,z)))
        let v := dotProduct x y + h s + ∑ i, word s i * b i * c i
        if C.eval (bits n x ++ bits n y) = decide (v = 1) then (1 : ℝ) else -1) / 2^(n+base)
    let fits := fun (p : ℕ) (C : Circ) => legal (2*n) C ∧ cost C ≤ p
    ∀ (E : Finset S) (a : S), a ∈ E →
      let W := Submodule.span F (Set.image (fun s : S => s-a) (↑E : Set S))
      let d := Module.finrank F W
      let varying := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i =>
        ∃ s ∈ E, word s i ≠ word a i)).card
      let price := base+d+varying
      let side := fun (l : S) (b : F) => E.filter (fun s => dotProduct l s ≠ b)
      let mass := fun (z : S → ℝ) (B : Finset S) => ∑ s ∈ B, z s
      let cover := fun (z : S → ℝ) => (∀ s ∈ E, 0 ≤ z s) ∧
        (∀ (l : S) (b : F), (side l b).Nonempty → side l b ≠ E → 1 ≤ mass z (side l b)) ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin m) (b : F), (side (A i) b).Nonempty → side (A i) b ≠ E →
          2 ≤ mass z (side (A i) b)
      let extension := ∃ (o : F) (l : S) (M : Fin k → Fin k → F), ∀ s ∈ E,
        h s = o + dotProduct l s + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * s i * s j
      0 < d → ∀ w : S → ℝ, (∀ s ∈ E, 0 < w s) →
        let total := fun (z : S → ℝ) => ∑ s ∈ E, w s * z s
        let feasible := fun (q : ℝ) =>
          ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Circ) (v : Fin N → ℝ),
            (∀ i, fits (price-1) (C i) ∧ 0 ≤ v i) ∧ (∑ i, v i) = 1 ∧
            ∀ s ∈ E, 1-(∑ i, v i * score (C i) s) ≤ q*w s
        ∃ z : S → ℝ, cover z ∧ 0 < total z ∧
          (∀ y : S → ℝ, cover y → total z ≤ total y) ∧
          (∀ q : ℝ, feasible q → 1 ≤ q * total z) ∧
          (extension → feasible (1 / total z) ∧
            (∀ p : ℕ, (∃ C : Circ, fits p C ∧ ∀ s ∈ E, score C s = 1) ↔ price ≤ p))
changed.unlocks: Determines the optimal simultaneous relative error on dependent selector promises with a quadratically extendible offset.
changed.context: A profile missing part of the promise loses a full affine cut side. One covering the promise must leave a varying column, losing half of one side. Cut the hull by a hyperplane or retain that column to realize these deficits when a quadratic fits the offset. A cover assigns each loss vector mass at least one. Dualize its weighted minimum: pack the realizable losses under each selector tolerance and normalize by the total packing mass. This gives one mixture for all selectors. A better guarantee cannot exist by integrating the elementary deficits against a minimum cover.

changed.title: Fibonacci numbers and one signed recurrence price consecutive mixed-site questions throughout the singular column bank
changed.statement:
∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (h : ℕ), 3 ≤ h → h+2 ≤ 3*t →
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 5) ht)⟩ : Fin n)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (i : Fin n) => w (ix (i.val + n - s % n))
  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let run := fun (ask : Fin h → ℕ → W →ₗ[F] F) (w : W) =>
    (List.finRange h).foldl (fun z i => 2*z + (if ask i z w = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let m := 3*t-h
  let lo : ℤ := if m % 3 = 0 then 6 else if m % 3 = 1 then 11 else 19
  let hi : ℤ := if m % 3 = 0 then 34 else if m % 3 = 1 then 63 else 111
  let correction := (((!![0,1;-1,6] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)^(m/3)).mulVec ![lo,hi]) 0
  ∀ (name c : W) (fixed : Bool) (k : ℕ), (fixed = true ∨ 100*(h+4)^2 ≤ t) →
    ((∃ (ask : Fin h → ℕ → W →ₗ[F] F) (A : ℕ → W →ₗ[F] W) (b : ℕ → W),
      (fixed = true → ∀ j p w, ask j p w = mix w (ix (2*j.val))) ∧
      k ≤ Nat.card {w : W // out name c w = A (run ask w) w + b (run ask w)}) ↔
      (k : ℤ) ≤ 2^(2*h-1)*((Nat.fib (2*m+3) : ℤ)+correction))

changed.title: Which optimal depth-one one-hot fan-in-two banks can avoid mixing forbidden row-block pairs
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let F := ZMod 2
∀ (q l : ℕ) (s : Fin l → ℕ),
  let V := Fin q → F
  let I := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (2*s i)
  let M := Matrix I I F
  let dot := fun (a z : V) => ∑ k, a k * z k
  ∀ (a b : Fin l → V), (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    let line := fun i : Fin l => ({a i,b i,a i+b i} : Finset V)
    Function.Injective line →
    ∀ (U W : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (2*s i)) (Fin (2*s i)) F),
      (∀ i, (U i).rank = 2*s i ∧ (W i).rank = 2*s i ∧ (U i + W i).rank = 2*s i) →
      let K := fun (z : V) =>
        Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => dot (a i) z • U i + dot (b i) z • W i)
      ∀ t : ℕ, 2*t = 3*(∑ i, s i) →
        ∀ near : Fin l → Fin l → Bool, (∀ i, near i i = true) →
          (∀ i j, near i j = near j i) →
          let J := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (s i)
          let w := Fintype.card I
          let coord := Fintype.equivFin I
          let width := (w+1)+(w+1)
          let table := fun (z : V) (x y : Fin (w+1)) =>
            Fin.cases false (fun i => Fin.cases false (fun j =>
              decide (K z (coord.symm i) (coord.symm j) ≠ 0)) y) x
          let mixed := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (j : Fin C.gates.length)
              (x y : I) =>
            let val := fun (r c : Fin (w+1)) =>
              (⟨C.gates,width+j.val⟩ : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit).eval
                (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach r c)
            xor (xor (val (coord x).succ (coord y).succ) (val (coord x).succ 0))
              (xor (val 0 (coord y).succ) (val 0 0))
          let crossing := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
            ∑ j : Fin C.gates.length, if nonlinear (C.gates.get j) then
              @ite ℕ (∃ x y x' y' : I, near x.1 x'.1 = false ∧
                mixed C j x y = true ∧ mixed C j x' y' = true)
                (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0 else 0
          ∀ k : ℕ,
            (∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (tap : V → ℕ),
              PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack width C ∧
              (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t ∧
              crossing C ≤ k ∧ ∀ z : V, (depths width C).getD (tap z) 0 ≤ 1 ∧
                PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (table z) ⟨C.gates,tap z⟩) ↔
              ∃ mate : V → J → J,
                (∀ u x, u ∈ line x.1 → u ∈ line (mate u x).1 ∧
                  mate u x ≠ x ∧ mate u (mate u x) = x) ∧
                (∑ u : V, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : J =>
                  u ∈ line x.1 ∧ near x.1 (mate u x).1 = false)).card) ≤ 2*k

changed.statement:
∀ errors : ℕ, ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ t : ℕ, 2 ≤ t →
  let T := Fin t
  let V := Option (T × Bool)
  let Pair := {p : T × T // p.1 < p.2}
  let E := Fin 3 × T
  let Mask := T → Fin 3
  let tail := fun e : E => if e.1 = 0 then some (e.2,false) else (none : V)
  let head := fun e : E => some (e.2,decide (e.1 ≠ 1))
  let weight := fun (g : Option Pair) (e : E) (diff : Bool) =>
    if e.1 = 0 then diff.toNat else if e.1 = 2 then 1 else
    if g.elim false (fun p => decide (p.val.1 = e.2 ∨ p.val.2 = e.2)) then
      (if diff then 1 else 3) else (2 : ℕ)
  let obs := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    ∑ x : V → Bool, if (∀ i : T, p i = 0 ∨ p i = (if x (some (i,false)) then 2 else 1)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : E => x (tail e) ≠ x (head e))).card = 2*t then
      ∏ e : E, weight g e (xor (x (tail e)) (x (head e))) else 0
  let raw := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
    g.elim (0 : Fin 3) (fun e => if p e.val.1 = 0 ∨ p e.val.2 = 0 then 0
      else if p e.val.1 = p e.val.2 then 1 else 2)
  let answer := fun (g : Option Pair) (p : Mask) =>
